'''Morris William Hirsch''' (born June 28, 1933) is an American [[mathematician]], formerly at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].

A native of [[Chicago, Illinois]], Hirsch attained his [[doctorate]] from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1958, under supervision of [[Edwin Spanier]] and [[Stephen Smale]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=6481}}</ref> His thesis was entitled ''Immersions of Manifolds''. In 2012, he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-01-21.</ref>

Hirsch had 23 doctoral students, including [[William Thurston]], [[William Goldman (mathematician)|William Goldman]], and [[Mary Lou Zeeman]].
